question: Variation is useful for the survival of species over time. These variations occur due to errors in:
solution:
The correct answer is __**DNA copying**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Variations are crucial for the survival and evolution of species, providing a way for organisms to adapt to changing environments.
 
• These variations occur due to errors in the DNA copying process during cell division.
 
• Such errors, known as mutations, can introduce new traits in organisms which may enhance their survival and reproduction.
 
• While some mutations can be harmful, others can be beneficial and contribute to the genetic diversity of a population.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **DNA Replication:**

 
 
• DNA replication is the process by which a DNA molecule makes a copy of itself during cell division.
 
• It ensures that each new cell receives an exact copy of the organism's genetic material.
 
• The process involves enzymes like DNA polymerase, which helps in adding nucleotides to the growing DNA strand.
 
 
 
• **Mutation:**
 
 
• A mutation is a change in the DNA sequence that can lead to variations in the genetic code.
 
• Mutations can occur spontaneously or be induced by external factors such as radiation and chemicals.
 
• They play a critical role in evolution by introducing new genetic variations.
 
 
 
• **Genetic Variation:**
 
 
• Genetic variation refers to the differences in DNA sequences among individuals within a population.
 
• It is essential for natural selection, as it provides the raw material for evolutionary change.
 
• High genetic variation within a population increases its ability to adapt to environmental changes.
 
 
 
• **Natural Selection:**
 
 
• Natural selection is the process by which organisms with advantageous traits are more likely to survive and reproduce.
 
• Over time, these advantageous traits become more common within the population.
 
• Natural selection drives the evolution of species by favoring traits that enhance survival and reproductive success.
